From: Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Date: Wed, Apr 13, 2022 at 2:38 PM
Subject: Request for Meeting between YouTube CEO Susan Wojcicki and Administrator Power
To: Nikole Burroughs <[contact omitted]>, Colin Thomas-Jensen <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Sophia Lalani <[contact omitted]>
Hi USAID Friends,
I wanted to reach out to see if Administrator Power may be in town and interested in meeting with YouTube CEO,
Susan Wojcicki, who will be in Washington on April 28 and 29.
Susan would like to request a meeting with Administrator Power to discuss a range of critical issues of mutual interest
including: access to information globally; combating misinformation and disinformation globally, as well as YouTube's
positive economic, social, and civic impact, in democracies, as well as in closed and illiberal societies in across the the
world. She'd also love to discuss how we might work together on these shared values.
Please let me know if you have any questions or need any additional information from me (Susan's bio is below).
Many thanks,
Josh
Google
Public Policy
Joshua R. Blumenfel
